title: Clinical evaluation of [99mTc]Tc-PSMA-P1: a promising SPECT radiotracer for prostate cancer imaging
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,29097-29108
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04397B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Maria Hassan, Tanveer Hussain Bokhari, Faiz Ahmed, Yun-Sang Lee, Nadeem Ahmed Lodhi
This study aimed to design and synthesize a prostate-specific membrane antigen inhibitor (PSMA-P1) and to formulate a freeze-dried kit for radiolabeling with Technetium-99m (99mTc) to improve prostate cancer detection.
